svg.title: AI-Powered Supply Chain Pipeline Architecture
svg.desc: Seven-layer architecture from SAP data sources through Airflow orchestration, dbt transformations, DuckDB warehouse, AI/ML models, to a serving layer.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do I connect to SAP MM OData APIs for materials management data ingestion?')
sendPrompt('How do I connect to SAP SD OData APIs for sales order and delivery data?')
sendPrompt('How do I integrate SAP WM and Inventory Management APIs into an Airflow pipeline?')
sendPrompt('Which procurement and sourcing APIs should I use for supplier and PO data?')
sendPrompt('How should I structure Airflow 2.x DAGs for SAP data ingestion with retries and SLA monitoring?')
g.text: DAG orchestration · scheduling · retry logic · SLA monitoring · backfill

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What dbt models should I write for the Bronze raw ingestion layer from SAP sources?')
sendPrompt('What dbt models should I write for the Silver cleansed layer — typing, deduplication, validation?')
sendPrompt('What dbt models should I write for the Gold marts layer — inventory KPIs, demand signals, supplier scores?')
sendPrompt('Why should I use DuckDB and MotherDuck as a free student data warehouse for supply chain analytics?')
g.text: OLAP warehouse · free tier · columnar · embeddable · Parquet-native

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do I build a production-grade demand forecasting model using Prophet and ARIMA on DuckDB data?')
sendPrompt('How do I build an ML-powered reorder point and EOQ optimization engine?')
sendPrompt('How do I integrate Claude API as an LLM advisor for supply chain recommendations?')
sendPrompt('How should I structure the FastAPI backend and upgraded Streamlit dashboard for this supply chain system?')
g.text: FastAPI · Streamlit v2 · WebSocket live updates · JWT auth
